issues.suggested_action: Grade cards to warm paper ~luma 170 with 4% grain and dip from her face through a 6-frame exposure ramp, or set the turn line on a dark frame

issues.evidence: sat 185.2, 198.7, 201.6, 183.1 on night office shots; window bokeh is electric cyan, not night blue
issues.suggested_action: Pull sat to ~120-135 in the night world; hue-shift window blues from cyan toward 220°; keep the lamp at 3200K amber

issues.evidence: UI shots luma 139.5/143.0 white pages (f26/f36, contrast 100) beside 19-27 luma navy panels; letterbox only on these (25% of shots)
issues.suggested_action: Pull UI whites to 85% (IRE ~215), add the night-world grain and 0.15 halation; apply the 2.39 letterbox to all film shots or none

issues.evidence: Canva face shots are cold blue-black with no warm lamp, unlike f16/f20 where brass lamp is warm amber

issues.evidence: Dawn f39 is golden saturated, sat 98, bright; deliberate world change but lamp still on and set differs
issues.suggested_action: Keep the warm dawn but lower highlight roll-off and match grain; this is the earned colour change, it can stay
Ensure the softness is intended DOF and not upscale mush; sharpen subject plane, add grain to mask

constraint_failures.rule: UI frames left raw and white beside graded film
constraint_failures.evidence: luma 139.5/143.0, contrast ~100, white document pages vs navy night

constraint_failures.rule: hard grade jump inside one scene

grade_recipe.night_office: eq=saturation=0.75:gamma=0.95, colorbalance=rs=0.04:bs=-0.02:rh=0.06:bh=-0.04 (warm highlights from lamp, blues held in shadows only), curves lift 0.04 black, gain 0.92, grain 6 (noise=alls=6:allf=t), vignette PI/5
grade_recipe.ui_inserts: curves white point 0.85, colorbalance bh=0.03 (cool screen), same grain 6, glow/halation 0.15 on highlights, no separate letterbox
grade_recipe.cards: cream to luma ~170, grain 4, no grey ellipse vignette; or invert to ink #161616 field with cream type
grade_recipe.dawn: colorbalance rh=0.08:gh=0.03, saturation 0.9, highlight roll-off, grain 6

luma 27->143 navy panel to white memo page
